text:
Kai: Thinking of doing a chill indie Steam swap + projector high-score challenge this Friday in the mezz. bring games youd like to show off or trade keys for :sparkles: :video_game:
Nora: love this. i have a pile of itch/steam keys i'd barter. also can bring a mini bluetooth speaker and some fairy lights to make it vibe.
Ben: projector? does the mezz have HDMI and audio out? i can bring an HDMI switch and a little amp.
Priya: count me in. i'm allergic to competitive stress but i will absolutely participate in a high-score leaderboard for casual games.
Leo: can we also do a co-op block? Thinking Enter the Gungeon duo runs or cuphead (for masochists).
Kai: co-op block yes. non-competitive friendly ladder: short runs only so people can rotate.
Nora: quick poll: who wants ramen+snacks? react :ramen: for ramen, :popcorn: for snacks, :no_entry_sign: for neither. i will order.
Ben: :ramen:
Priya: :popcorn:
Leo: :ramen: + can bring hot sauce packets
Kai: logistics note: mezz audio is weird after 8pm so we should test sound at 6:45. ops-bot can you reserve the mezz for 7-10pm?
ops-bot: Reservation request received. Pending approval from facilities. If all clear, event will be reserved 19:00-22:00.
Nora: also who has spare controllers? i have one PS4 wireless pad and a Switch Pro, but extra USB pads would be great.
Ben: i have two wired USB pads and a USB hub. bringing both.
Priya: i'll bring a PS3 DualShock (adapter needed) and a handheld charger.
Leo: i'll bring my Steam Deck for portable co-op and some local-only indies.
Kai: sweet. can anyone bring an HDMI->VGA adapter? projector older model.
Ben: have one. i'll pack it.
Priya: curious idea: small 10-minute "best score" challenges between set rotations. winner gets a silly trophy (i can 3D-print a tiny pixel heart).
Nora: obsessive yes. pixel heart is peak office culture.
Kai: schedule idea: 7:00-7:30 setup / network check, 7:30-9:00 indie swap + co-op ladder, 9:00-9:30 high-score quickies, 9:30-10 wrap and cleanup.
ops-bot: Facilities approved. Event "Indie Swap + Projector High-score" added to calendar. https://calendar.example.com/event/1996015678
Ben: volunteer list for teardown? i'm good to stay until 10:15.
Leo: I can help carry gear down and tidy up.
Nora: i'll grab ramen order once Kai confirms headcount.
Kai: awesome. RSVP please (quick) with a :thumbsup: and what you're bringing. i'll post final list and a tiny table of games so people can queue up. :v:
